name: Weekly Order Report
author: Rohan Patel

sections.description:
Weekly Order Report is a powerful WordPress plugin that automatically generates and sends comprehensive WooCommerce order reports to specified email addresses on a weekly basis.

Features

  • Automated Weekly Reports – Schedule reports to be sent automatically on any day of the week at your preferred time
  • Flexible Scheduling – Choose the day and time (12-hour format) for automatic report delivery
  • Multiple Recipients – Send reports to multiple email addresses (comma-separated)
  • Instant Send Option – Send reports immediately with the “Send Report Now” button
  • Specific Date Scheduling – Schedule one-time reports for specific dates and times
  • Timezone Support – Fully compatible with WordPress timezone settings (DST-safe)
  • Easy Configuration – Simple settings page under Settings > Weekly Order Report
  • WooCommerce Integration – Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce order data

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Navigate to Settings > Weekly Order Report
  3. Configure recipient email addresses
  4. Select the day and time for automatic weekly reports
  5. Save your settings and the plugin handles the rest!

Perfect For

  • Store owners who need regular order summaries
  • Managers tracking weekly sales performance
  • Accountants requiring periodic order reports
  • Teams needing automated order notifications

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce plugin installed and activated
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please contact the plugin author.

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data from your website visitors. It only processes WooCommerce order data that already exists in your WordPress database and sends email reports to the addresses you configure.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Weekly Order Report”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Configuration

  1. After activation, go to Settings > Weekly Order Report
  2. Enter recipient email addresses (comma-separated for multiple recipients)
  3. Select your preferred day of the week for reports
  4. Choose the time for report delivery (12-hour format)
  5. Click “Save Changes”
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is designed to work with WooCommerce and requires it to be installed and activated.

Can I send reports to multiple email addresses?

Yes! Simply enter multiple email addresses separated by commas in the Recipient Emails field.

What timezone is used for scheduling?

The plugin uses your WordPress site’s timezone setting, which you can configure under Settings > General > Timezone.

Can I send a report immediately?

Yes, use the “Send Report Now” button on the settings page to generate and send a report instantly.

Can I schedule a one-time report?

Yes, the plugin includes a “Specific Date” section where you can schedule a one-time report for any future date and time.

What happens if I change the scheduled time?

When you save changes, if the selected day/time is in the past for the current week, the report will be sent immediately. Otherwise, it will be scheduled for the next occurrence of that day/time.

How do I cancel a scheduled specific date report?

If you have a specific date report scheduled, you’ll see a “Cancel Scheduled Report” button in the settings page.
